findings.title: HPA cannot scale on cpu: container has no cpu request
findings.message: HPA orders-service targets 70% cpu utilization, but container orders-service declares no cpu request. Utilization is undefined, so the HPA takes no action for this metric.
findings.requirement: Resource metrics with target type Utilization require a request for that resource on every container in the pod.

assumptions.statement: no namespace LimitRange or webhook injects a default cpu request at admission

remediation.summary: Add resources.requests.cpu to every container in the pod template, or switch the HPA target to AverageValue.

findings.title: Readiness probe targets a port where actuator is not served
findings.message: management.server.port is 8081, so /actuator/** is served only on 8081. The readiness probe calls 8080/actuator/health/readiness and will get 404.
findings.requirement: With a DIFFERENT management port, probe groups are served at management.server.port + management.server.base-path + /actuator/health/<group>.
findings.computation: ManagementPortType: management 8081 != server 8080 -> DIFFERENT. Expected 8081/actuator/health/readiness; probe 8080/actuator/health/readiness.

assumptions.statement: out-of-repo environment sources do not override these values

remediation.summary: Point the probe at port: management (8081), as the livenessProbe does, or enable add-additional-paths and probe 8080/readyz.

blocking_ineligible_reasons: rule not yet promoted to blocking: needs runtime and boundary-case tests (D5)

findings.title: PaymentClient can wait forever on the payment service
findings.message: `new RestTemplate()` uses SimpleClientHttpRequestFactory with no connect or read timeout. spring.http.client.* does not apply to a RestTemplate constructed directly.
findings.requirement: Outbound HTTP calls on a request path need a bounded connect and read timeout.

remediation.summary: Inject RestTemplateBuilder (or RestClient.Builder) so spring.http.client.* apply, or set a factory with explicit timeouts.

blocking_ineligible_reasons: rule not yet promoted to blocking: needs runtime and boundary-case tests (D5)

findings.title: Production profile exposes all actuator endpoints
findings.message: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=prod activates application-prod.yml, which sets exposure.include to "*" (heapdump, env, configprops, loggers). The comment says this was temporary (INC-2291).
findings.requirement: The effective production profile should expose only the endpoints operations needs.

assumptions.statement: out-of-repo environment sources do not override these values

remediation.summary: Remove the override from application-prod.yml; the base file exposes health,info,prometheus.

findings.title: Rollout can drop below the PDB minAvailable floor
findings.message: PDB orders-service requires 75% of pods available, but the rolling update allows 50% unavailable. PDBs do not limit rolling updates.
findings.requirement: Ready pods during rollout (n - floor(maxUnavailable)) should not fall below ceil(minAvailable) for any replica count the HPA allows.

remediation.summary: Set maxUnavailable to 25% or lower, or lower minAvailable if 75% was not a real floor.

findings.title: Shutdown budget 55s exceeds pod grace period 30s
findings.message: preStop sleeps 10s, then Spring waits up to 45s per shutdown phase for in-flight requests. Kubernetes sends SIGKILL at 30s.
findings.requirement: preStop duration plus graceful drain budget must fit inside terminationGracePeriodSeconds.
findings.computation: 10s preStop + 45s timeout-per-shutdown-phase = 55s > 30s terminationGracePeriodSeconds (field absent, Kubernetes default)

assumptions.statement: out-of-repo environment sources do not override these values

remediation.summary: Set terminationGracePeriodSeconds to at least 60, or lower timeout-per-shutdown-phase to 20s or less.

blocking_ineligible_reasons: rule not yet promoted to blocking: needs runtime and boundary-case tests (D5)

findings.title: ShippingQuoteClient likely has no read timeout
findings.message: Static RestClient.builder() ignores spring.http.client.* and picks a factory by classpath. With the declared dependencies that is the JDK client, which has no read timeout by default.
findings.requirement: Outbound HTTP calls on a request path need a bounded read timeout.

assumptions.statement: no transitive dependency adds Apache HttpClient 5, Jetty or Reactor Netty (any of them changes the factory)

conditional_reasons: no transitive dependency adds Apache HttpClient 5, Jetty or Reactor Netty (any of them changes the factory)

remediation.summary: Inject RestClient.Builder instead of calling RestClient.builder().

findings.title: Deployment sets spec.replicas while an HPA manages it
findings.message: Each kubectl apply resets replicas to 4, undoing the HPA until it reconciles.
findings.requirement: Kubernetes recommends removing spec.replicas when an HPA is enabled.

assumptions.statement: the deploy tool applies spec.replicas (Argo CD and Flux can be set to ignore it)
